info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Corporate Treasury Analysi Review-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of reviews for corporate treasury analyses, enabling enterprises to evaluate and enhance their financial management strategies. It allows users to send comprehensive feedback on specific treasury analyses identified by a unique parameter. Typical consumers include finance teams and treasury analysts seeking to assess treasury performance and implement recommendations for improvement. This API streamlines the review process and fosters collaboration within financial operations.

post.summary: Create a review for the corporate treasury analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for a specific corporate treasury analysis identified by RES-100045. The review can include feedback on the analysis' accuracy, usefulness, and any other pertinent comments that can contribute to enhancing the quality of corporate treasury assessments.
